provenance.fpocketVersion: 4.0 Windows port (XDrugPy binary linked in upstream issue 106)
provenance.configuration: default for both methods; experimental X-ray coordinates

centerDefinition.fpocket: Unweighted centroid of the output alpha-sphere centers

provenance.distanceDefinition: Minimum distance in angstroms between the candidate center and any of the 23 maltose heavy atoms. Display reference only, no accuracy threshold.
provenance.scope: Personal teaching case, not an independent benchmark. Input may resemble model training data. One example cannot establish relative method quality.
